title: Ashen Realm - A Soulslike Music Pack - 44 Tracks
tagline: 44 track soulslike score. Every loop breathes, near silence to eruption. Bonfire, ruins, nine fights. MIDI + OGG.
description:
Ashen Realm is a 44 track soulslike score for games: a kingdom gone to ash, its roads and ruins, its cathedral and its barrows, nine fights from a common battle to the final boss, and one bonfire. Every full piece is written the way the genre scores its spaces: long near silence, then a swell or an eruption, then back to the quiet.

The breath, checked on the shipped audio. Every track is mastered to the same overall loudness, so this is not a record of quiet tracks and loud tracks: each full piece carries its own quiet and its own loud inside the part that loops. Measured on the shipped OGG between its LOOPSTART and LOOPSTART + LOOPLENGTH tags, bar by bar, the loudest bar of every one of the 35 full pieces is at least 28 dB louder than its quietest bar (the swings run from 28.3 to 37.5 dB), and the quietest bar never drops below -60 dB, so the quiet is music and not a gap. We measured the 706 looping pieces of our earlier albums the same way: their median swing is 8.2 dB and none of them reaches 28.

What is in it. 35 full pieces and 9 short cues, 60:06 of music. The fire: Ashen Realm, The Bonfire and The Shrine of Embers. The roads and the wilds: The Cinder Road, The Ash Fields, The Greywood, The Greywood at Night, The Drowned Fen, The Fen of Lanterns, The Frozen Pass, The High Ash at Night and Mist on the Ashen Lake. The ruined kingdom: The Emptied Town, The Fallen Walls, The Broken Tower, The Archive of Dust, The Hollow Court, The Cold Feast Hall and The Undercroft. The holy places and the deep ones: The Ruined Oratory, The Cathedral of Ash, The Ossuary, The Barrow of Kings and The Ember Mines. The fights: Hollowed, The Ashen Knight, The Gatekeeper, The Mother of Moths, Cinders Falling Like Rain, The Wyrm of the Last Flame, The King Unmasked, The Last Ember and Against the Dying Light. After: The Fire Passed On and Ash on the Wind. Cues: Foe Felled, Fallen, Kindled, Strength Returns, An Ember Claimed, Something Waits Beyond, A New Ruin, An Invader, The Old Horn Sounds.

What you get. 44 OGG files, 35 of them with sample accurate LOOPSTART and LOOPLENGTH tags, which is what RPG Maker MV and MZ read. 44 editable .mid sources. A Readme with per engine import notes, both proof reports, and a royalty free commercial licence.

One family of 5 cells, from the bonfire. Kindle, Ash, Hollow, Knell, Wrath. Kindle is the bonfire: it climbs a third, steps back and climbs to end a fourth higher. Ash is Kindle upside down, and it is the whole ruined world. Hollow sighs a step down before it reaches up a third. Knell falls a third twice in a row, for the holy places and the buried ones. Wrath opens a fifth straight down and climbs back, and every fight on the record opens on it. 1085 statements and fragments of those cells across the album, counted by the harness in the finished MIDI.

Gate results. 782 theory checks and 501 audio checks, 0 failed, and both reports ship inside the download. They say the music is correctly written, rendered and tagged. They are not a claim about taste, which is what the two free tracks are for.

Two full tracks are free on this page, with their MIDI: Ashen Realm, the title, a breath that swells, and The Mother of Moths, the boss, a held breath and then the eruption. Loop either one in your engine and let it come round.

The renders are a General MIDI reference render through a conventional soundfont. The composition system is AI written code and no generative audio model is used anywhere.

devlog.title: Ashen Realm is out: a 44 track soulslike score where every loop breathes
devlog.body:
Ashen Realm is a 44 track soulslike score for games: a kingdom gone to ash, its roads, ruins, cathedral and barrows, nine fights up to the final boss, and one bonfire. It is live now, with 2 full tracks free to download from the page.

The idea. Soulslike scores live on contrast: long near silence, then the whole orchestra at once. Every track here is mastered to the same loudness, so the contrast has to live inside each track, and it is written into the part that loops. Measured on the shipped OGG files, between the loop tags, the loudest bar of every full piece is at least 28 dB louder than its quietest, and the quietest never drops below -60 dB. The 706 looping pieces on our earlier albums have a median of 8.2 dB measured the same way.

What is in it. 35 full pieces and 9 short cues, 60:06 of music: the bonfire and the shrine, nine roads and wild places, seven rooms of the ruined kingdom, five holy and buried places, nine fights and two pieces for the end. 35 tracks loop on sample accurate LOOPSTART and LOOPLENGTH tags that RPG Maker reads directly, and the editable .mid ships beside every .ogg.

How it was checked. 782 theory checks and 501 audio checks, 0 failed, with both reports inside the download. Those numbers say the music is correctly written, rendered and tagged. They are not a claim about taste, which is what the free pair (Ashen Realm and The Mother of Moths) is for.

The renders are a General MIDI reference render through a conventional soundfont. The composition system is AI written code and no generative audio model is used.
